tools.name: search_contact_emails
tools.object: Gmail correspondence with a specific contact
tools.description: Search the shared inbox for email messages from or about a given contact, returning matching messages with their Message-IDs, dates, and body excerpts.

tools.name: list_recent_email_threads
tools.object: recent email threads for a contact
tools.description: List recent email threads involving the contact in reverse-chronological order so the most recently stated information can be identified.

tools.name: retrieve_salesforce_contact
tools.description: Retrieve the current Salesforce contact record, including stored phone number, owner, and last-modified metadata.

tools.name: retrieve_salesforce_account
tools.description: Retrieve the parent Salesforce account record for context, including main line and associated contacts.

tools.name: compare_contact_field_values
tools.object: candidate phone numbers versus the stored field value
tools.description: Compare the phone numbers found across recent emails against the value currently stored on the contact and determine the most recent authoritative source.

tools.name: draft_contact_update_summary
tools.object: proposed contact update summary with supporting Message-ID
tools.description: Prepare a summary of the proposed phone-number update, citing the authoritative source Message-ID and the field's current versus proposed value, for the user to review before any record change.

tools.name: create_salesforce_note
tools.object: audit note on the Salesforce contact record
tools.description: Create and persist an audit-trail note on the Salesforce contact record documenting the source of a field change.

tools.name: update_salesforce_contact_field
tools.object: phone number field on the Salesforce contact
tools.description: Write a new value to a field on the live Salesforce contact record, overwriting the existing stored value.

tools.name: send_contact_confirmation_email
tools.object: confirmation email to the external contact
tools.description: Send an email to the contact confirming that their phone number on file has been updated.

tools.name: lookup_data_hygiene_policy
tools.description: Look up the sales operations data-hygiene policy for rules on sourcing and approving contact field changes.
